title: We program the process that shapes the brain
label: Shaping
description: A compact learning rule can shape a rich repertoire of behavior. Understanding that process does not fully characterize what it produces.
visual: Two contour maps connected by a training update; the resulting map contains a path between situations.

title: Context brings different patterns into play
label: Context
description: The weights can stay fixed while a new request, tool result or peer message brings a different combination of learned patterns into play.
visual: Two copies of the same learned policy receive different requests; the weights remain unchanged.

title: Useful habits learn to work together
label: Composition
description: Persistence with tools can automate retries. Persistence with collaboration can recruit help. We want these combinations to inherit the right limits.
visual: Overlapping contours in one learned policy illustrate persistence, tool use and collaboration.

title: The same habits can cross a boundary
label: Authority
description: A familiar request to change the goal can come from a user or a peer. The missing distinction is who has authority to replace the goal.
visual: A trajectory with a violation, separated by an observation boundary from a recorded PASS.

title: Alignment has to shape the combinations
label: Alignment
description: Training reshapes shared behavior. Individual and connected-agent tests reveal different parts of the result.
visual: Checked evaluation points on a contour map, with a dashed path toward an untested situation.

title: Some boundaries belong outside the model
label: Safeguards
description: Training shapes the request. Infrastructure can enforce a permission even when the request is wrong.
visual: A path leaving a learned contour map is stopped by a separate access-control gate.

title: Alignment has to shape the combinations
label: Connected agents
description: One agent’s output becomes another’s context. Individual tests do not establish how the connected system behaves.
visual: Three separate contour maps connected by communication arrows and a shared hub.

title: The optimizer can be simple. The behavior does not have to be.
label: Conclusion
description: What changed my mind was how much confidence I had placed in shaping behavior, inspecting a few outcomes, and concluding that the intended boundaries had generalized.
visual: A path on a contour map branches toward three open questions.
